targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [failure_autopsy_hazard-avoidance-prerequisite-cluster_2026-09-09, user-ratified with red-team] V3-EXQ-999a (2026-09-09, ree-cloud-2, 7h04m, 5 seeds x 5 heartbeat levels) NON-CONTRIBUTORY for MECH-161: the claim's SHAPE premise was never evaluated. THE RUN CARRIES A POSITIVE FINDING ITS OWN VERDICT HIDES, and it points the OPPOSITE way from this autopsy's first draft: on the decision-tick readout the AGENT sits ABOVE the hazard-blind null at 4 of 5 heartbeat levels -- agent-minus-null +0.1388, +0.1132, +0.0989 (at P_train=10), +0.1617, and -0.0095 at P20 -- i.e. 12.4 to 21.3 per cent of the oracle-minus-null range. Weak hazard sensitivity IS present in a warmup-trained agent. Any reading of this run as showing that avoidance does not exist is falsified by its own metrics block, and the first draft of this artifact made exactly that error before the Step 7c pass caught it. WHAT ACTUALLY BLOCKED THE RUN is that the HIGH-versus-SAFE band contrast could not be computed for the agent: agent_safe_bin_executable_decision_ticks_covered 3.0 against a 10 floor (seed23/P20) with safe_bin_wall_clamp_fraction_worst 0.985 (seed45/P10), so the trained agent's SAFE-bin decision ticks are almost entirely wall-clamped no-ops. baseline_avoidance_clears_derived_bar reads mean -0.1013 over 5 seeds (SD 0.3139, SE 0.1404, 0.72 SE from zero, two of five seeds positive) -- underpowered and computed over that same starved bin. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE DRIVER'S OWN registry_adjudication, both independently confirmed at the red-team pass and both standing. (1) H-env-band-absent is stamped 'eliminated' on safe_cov_ok, a coverage count taken on the CONTROL arms; the agent-arm gate failed in the same run and the driver's own wall-clamp diagnostic -- explicitly RECORDED and NOT gating -- reads 0.985, so the quantity that undercuts the coverage read was excluded from the gate that used it. NARROWED, not eliminated. (2) H-avoidance-untrained is stamped 'supported' on that 0.72-SE statistic. NOT SUPPORTED, and now positively counter-indicated by the above-null result. A THIRD CORRECTION TO THIS AUTOPSY'S OWN FIRST DRAFT: the readout repair is real but was oversold. oracle_null_separation is near-tautological (the oracle sets held_idx = avoidant and the DV asks whether held_idx == avoidant, giving ~1 - 2/A ~ 0.6 analytically against a 0.20 floor), and the '999 oracle scored 0.0000' comparison sets 999's UNCONDITIONAL oracle against 999a's CONDITIONAL one, where the 999 artifact had already recorded +0.905 for a conditional avoider. Also: 999a retained the single-argmax _avoidant_action form inherited from V3-EXQ-981 -- the DV form 981a's own code documents as defective and replaced -- so this run and its cluster-mate are less independent than they look. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: the R1-R3 count for MECH-161 is 2 with this target, recorded honestly. It is NOT read as a substrate ceiling, and failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-999_2026-09-04 anticipated precisely this, leaving an in-artifact warning against reading a future count of 2 on MECH-161 as ceiling evidence; that warning is engaged here and upheld. Refused: a V3-EXQ-999b reusing the band-contrast statistic unchanged. Allowed and recommended: a re-run whose SAFE bin is executable for the agent (or which scores the shape on the above-null readout that already works), and separately a cheap config-arm probe enabling use_instrumental_avoidance / use_escape_affordance_bridge -- both built, both default-off, and never enabled by any run in this family. pending_retest_after_substrate stays true.

learning_extracted: A RUN'S VERDICT CAN HIDE ITS OWN POSITIVE RESULT. V3-EXQ-999a is a FAIL whose metrics block puts the agent above the hazard-blind null at 4 of 5 levels. The blocking gate and the informative readout were different statistics in the same manifest, and reading only the gate inverts the finding.
A COVERAGE GATE CERTIFIED ON CONTROL ARMS DOES NOT CERTIFY SCORABILITY OF THE AGENT ARM, and a count floor is not a scorability floor when the counted events can be no-ops.

AN ORACLE DEFINED AS TAKING THE CORRECT ACTION CANNOT FAIL A TEST THAT ASKS WHETHER IT TOOK THE CORRECT ACTION. oracle_null_separation here is ~1 - 2/A analytically; it is a useful coverage canary and NOT evidence that the instrument can measure the agent.

COMPARING A REPAIRED STATISTIC TO ITS PREDECESSOR REQUIRES THE SAME DEFINITION ON BOTH SIDES. The '0.0000 to 0.6984' improvement set an unconditional oracle against a conditional one; the conditional figure was already +0.905 in the predecessor's own artifact.

A DEFAULT-OFF FLAG IS THE FIRST THING TO CHECK BEFORE PROPOSING A BUILD. The avoidance-policy machinery this cluster was about to commission already existed behind use_instrumental_avoidance and use_escape_affordance_bridge, and the precedent the first draft cited (scaffold_train_harm_pathway) trains the VALUATION pathway both drivers already train -- so the citation contradicted the very distinction it was offered to support.

baseline_avoidance_clears_derived_bar.reading: The mean sits 0.72 standard errors from zero, with two of five seeds positive. This confirms the draft's statement that the statistic does not on its own establish absence of avoidance, and is why the draft declines to let 999a alone support H-avoidance-untrained.

learning_extracted: A positive control that survives the repair of its own confound becomes trustworthy evidence about the substrate. V3-EXQ-981's -0.4307 was dismissed as a geometry artifact and the dismissal was right; 981a re-based the same control onto availability-normalised lift, the reversal shrank to -0.0958 and did NOT flip, and the residual is now a measurement rather than an artifact.

Recording BOTH the confounded and the corrected statistic is what made this adjudication possible in one run rather than three. 981a stamped positive_control_margin_raw_rates (+0.0623) beside the lift-normalised margin (-0.0958); the sign disagreement between them IS the geometry confound, quantified, and it is only visible because both were recorded.

A prior autopsy's refusal to set pending_retest_after_substrate can be correct at the time and still need reversing on new evidence. The 2026-09-03 autopsy declined it because the fix was then a config flag; the repaired run reveals a genuinely missing capability. Reversing that call is a finding, not an inconsistency.

Aborting a two-stage run at Gate A is cheap and correct. Stage B never ran, so no compute was spent producing hypervigilance numbers that would have been uninterpretable against a non-avoidant baseline.

independent_recomputation.performed_by: the autopsy session itself, from the manifest's own per-seed bin counts, not taken from the driver's reported metrics
independent_recomputation.agreement: exact to 6 decimal places on both statistics
independent_recomputation.why_the_two_statistics_DISAGREE_IN_SIGN,: This is the load-bearing question for the whole cluster reading and the draft should not assert it without showing it. Availability-matched chance in the HIGH band is 0.3383 / 0.3447 / 0.4314 against 0.2153 / 0.2163 / 0.2194 in SAFE -- distance-increasing actions are 1.57x, 1.59x and 1.97x MORE AVAILABLE in HIGH than in SAFE, by grid geometry. A RAW rate therefore credits the agent for opportunity it did not create: it takes avoidant actions more often in HIGH simply because more of them exist there. Pooled raw rates are HIGH 0.0848 vs SAFE 0.0375. Subtracting availability gives pooled lifts of -0.2754 and -0.1797, and the sign of the margin flips. The lift statistic is the one that answers the question the positive control asks -- is the agent MORE avoidant where hazard is greater, controlling for how much avoidance was possible -- and the raw statistic answers a different question. Note also that the agent is BELOW availability-matched chance in BOTH bands on all three seeds, which no availability artifact explains.

cluster_pattern.shape: Two experiments on unrelated claims, both blocked at a pre-criterion positive control built on the same _avoidant_action / _hazard_bin band-contrast apparatus, and in both the band-contrast statistic is the fragile element rather than the agent's capability. V3-EXQ-999a: the agent's SAFE bin is starved (3 executable decision ticks at the worst cell against a 10 floor) and 98.5 per cent wall-clamped, so the HIGH-versus-SAFE contrast cannot be computed reliably -- while the SAME run's decision-tick readout puts the agent ABOVE the hazard-blind null at 4 of 5 levels. V3-EXQ-981a: the contrast's SIGN AND VERDICT depend on the normalisation choice (additive -0.0958 FAIL; ratio +0.0628 PASS; raw mean-of-seeds +0.0623 PASS), because at 10-40 per cent-of-availability response rates the additive form is dominated by the +0.143 availability gap rather than the +0.047 behavioural difference.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The shared HIGH-versus-SAFE band-contrast positive control is not a reliable instrument at floor response rates. It fails for a DIFFERENT proximate reason in each run -- bin starvation and wall-clamping in 999a, normalisation dependence in 981a -- but both reasons are properties of the band-contrast statistic rather than of the agent, and in 999a the agent's capability is visible on a readout that does not use the band contrast at all.
cluster_pattern.WITHDRAWN_READING: The first draft asserted a shared SUBSTRATE gap -- 'the substrate trains hazard valuation and no hazard-avoidance policy, so both positive controls correctly report a capability that does not exist'. WITHDRAWN on three independently verified grounds: the capability is weakly PRESENT (999a agent above null at 4 of 5 levels), 981a's negative reading is normalisation-dependent rather than robust, and the avoidance-policy machinery is already BUILT and merely default-off in both drivers. Recorded rather than deleted so a later session can see the reading was tested and did not hold.
cluster_pattern.what_neither_run_tested: Neither driver enables use_instrumental_avoidance or use_escape_affordance_bridge. So the question 'does a REE agent with its instrumental-avoidance machinery ENABLED express the band contrast these experiments need?' has never been asked, by either run, and is cheap to ask.

read_across_not_adjudicated.note: MECH-093 is a co-registered claim on the mech161_vigilance_arousal_shape_vs_readout question and is NOT adjudicated here.
